page.overview:
Who is Oromendil?

Oromendil was the first son and the second child of Nolondil. He had two siblings: Yávien, his older sister and Axantur, his younger brother. Nothing else is known of his life.

Oromendil means "Devoted to Oromë" in Quenya (from -dil = "friend, lover, devoted to").
